debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level: 0 = silent, 1 = minimal, 2–3 = detailed, 4+ = very verbose.

log_file_path.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

log_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of each log file before rotation. Set to 0 to disable size-based rotation.

ifaces.description: List of network interfaces to use for iSCSI offload traffic (e.g., ['eth1', 'eth2']). Leave empty to auto-detect offload-capable interfaces.

tcp_checksum_offload.description: Enable hardware TCP checksum offload for improved throughput.

tcp_seg_offload.description: Enable TCP segmentation offload (TSO) to reduce CPU load.

lro.description: Enable large receive offload (LRO) to coalesce incoming packets.

max_conns_per_interface.description: Maximum number of iSCSI connections allowed per network interface.

session_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for session recovery before failing over.

login_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for iSCSI login completion before timing out.

recovery_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for path recovery before marking path as failed.

path_management.description: Enable multipath I/O support (required for redundant paths).

mpath_algorithm.description: Multipath I/O path selection algorithm. Common values: 'round-robin', 'queue-depth', 'failover'.

auto_fw_load.description: Automatically load firmware from the kernel (recommended for most deployments).

fw_path.description: Optional absolute path to a custom firmware file. If empty, the default firmware will be used.

extra_modparams.description: Additional kernel module parameters as 'key=value' strings (e.g., ['ql4xdisablesrst=1', 'ql4xmaxlpivalue=256']).

items.description: A single kernel module parameter in 'key=value' format.
